claims.rationale: No status change: the Markovian-sufficiency claim (under simple ko + a fixed-value long-cycle verdict) remains UNTESTED, but the row's stated reason is false at HEAD and must be replaced — T372 (2026-08-05) built a shortest-arrival-first contrast generator (100% shortest hit vs the 93%-miss 2B-3 baseline, 23.4% shared prefix vs 62.35%) and ran the C1 probe with a null control and a seeded control that both fire, finding 0 C1 failures in 404 within-budget pairs across 24 C1-eligible states at 3x2 and 80 pairs across 6 states at 3x3, but at 84.3% and 93.3% budget exhaustion respectively — a lower bound, not a pass; the row's 'C1 has never been tested with contrasting histories' clause is therefore stale, and its third evidence citation `docs/audits/2b-3-audit-*.md` is a dead glob (real file: docs/audits/2026-07-29-2b-3-history-pairs-audit.md).

notes:

WHAT THE REFUTING LANE (T640/G01) ASSERTED, AND WHAT I RAN:
(a) The 93%/62% baseline reproduces: `sed -n '208,213p' docs/audits/2026-07-29-2b-3-history-pairs-audit.md` -> 'states where DFS misses the shortest path entirely | 28/30 (93%)' and 'avg shared prefix fraction (pairwise) | 62.35%'.
(b) The missing contrast test WAS built and run: docs/evidence/QA-023/c1-contrast-2026-08-05.md exists (19017 bytes) and ships src/t372_zrtie.zig (present at HEAD, 110718 bytes, mtime 2026-08-05). Its §5.1 reports 3x2 '129 states sampled ... 906 histories (441 shortest, 465 detours) ... 142 within-budget, 764 exhausted (84.3%); 404 within-budget history pairs across 24 C1-eligible states. C1: 0 failures'; §5.2 reports 3x3 '80 pairs across 6 C1-eligible states. C1: 0 failures'. §4.1 null control PASS (0 mismatches/64); §4.2 seeded control DETECTED (len_gt_dist: 152 disagreeing pairs / 10 states at 3x2, 32/2 at 3x3).
(c) The row's evidence column does not cite T372 anywhere: `grep -n 'c1-contrast-2026-08-05\|T372\|zrtie' docs/epistemic/CLAIMS.md` returns nothing. T372's own findings file (findings/T372-zrtie-contrast.json) has claims=[] — never absorbed.
(d) The dead glob: `ls docs/audits/2b-3-audit-*.md` -> 'No such file or directory'; the real file is docs/audits/2026-07-29-2b-3-history-pairs-audit.md.
All four legs of T640/G01's reproduction check out verbatim. T640 was factually right.

THE AMBIGUITY — THIS IS THE FINDING. The row has two parts that the race lanes read differently, so 'verified' and 'refuted' are BOTH defensible one-word verdicts: (1) the headline assertion ('the state (position, side, ko_point, passes) is Markovian'), which every lane agrees stays UNTESTED — T640's own status_should_be says 'Still UNTESTED as a headline'; (2) the load-bearing justification clause ('C1 has never been tested with contrasting histories'), which is FALSE at HEAD. T638 and T639 read part (1) and said 'verified' (status UNTESTED correct, rationale stale); T640 read part (2) and said 'refuted'; T641 checked only that the four cited files exist and said 'verified' without noticing the staleness; T642 said 'unverifiable-at-head' on a missing-evidence claim that is itself stale (the evidence is present as the date-prefixed file). The register's own wording does not pin down which part a verdict attaches to — a defect in the row independent of the claim's truth.

WHY THE HEADLINE IS NOT REFUTED AND NOT PROVEN. The claim is scoped to 'simple ko + a fixed-value long-cycle verdict'. The known C1 falsification (witness (178,0,6,0), -3 vs -6) is under first-revisit truncation (ADR-0019), a DIFFERENT rule, out of scope for this row (it belongs to GLOBAL.H1-COMPUTABLE / GLOBAL.LONGCYCLE). Under the row's own scope, T372's contrast probe found 0 failures — but at 84.3% (3x2) and 93.3% (3x3) budget exhaustion, so it is a lower bound with no weight as a pass beyond its denominator (24 and 6 eligible states). UNTESTED remains the honest status, with the reason corrected.
